sender: Dr. Osei, Consultant Cardiologist, St Thomas' Hospital
transcript:
Dear Dr. Patel,

Re: Mr. Hassan

Thank you for referring this patient for review of persistently raised blood pressure.

Impression
The key issue is hypertension which remains above target (148/92 at last check). Echocardiogram shows mild left ventricular hypertrophy, likely secondary to longstanding hypertension. No other structural abnormality was seen.

Plan
1. Increase Ramipril from 2.5mg to 5mg once daily.
2. Please recheck renal function and potassium in 4-6 weeks given the CKD history, as ACE inhibitor dose increases can affect both.
3. I will arrange a repeat echo in due course and will write again with the results.

Thank you for your ongoing care of this patient.

Yours sincerely,
Dr. Osei
Consultant Cardiologist

open_loops.description: Cardiology to write again with echo follow-up review
